operations.name: List supported proxy regions
operations.description: Returns regions supported by BrowserAct. You can pass a region code from this list as `proxyRegion` when running a template task.

operations.name: Retrieve a task
operations.description: Returns comprehensive information about a task, including: - current `status` - step-level progress (`steps`) - output (if finished) - failure details (if failed) If you only need the current status, use `GET /v2/workflow/get-task-status`.

operations.name: Retrieve a task status
operations.description: Returns just the current status of a task. This endpoint is more lightweight than `GET /v2/workflow/get-task`.

operations.name: Retrieve a workflow
operations.description: Fetches a workflow's configuration, including the **input parameter definitions** needed to run it. If you only need a list of workflows, use `GET /v2/workflow/list-workflows`.

operations.name: List workflows
operations.description: Returns a paginated list of workflows in your workspace. ### Pagination This endpoint uses page-based pagination with `page` and `limit`.

operations.name: Retrieve an official workflow template
operations.description: Fetches the configuration for an official workflow template, including input parameter definitions.

operations.name: List official workflow templates
operations.description: Returns BrowserAct's official workflow templates. Use `keyword` to search by name/description.

operations.name: List tasks
operations.description: Returns a paginated list of tasks (workflow executions). ### Filtering - Use `status` to filter by task status. - Use `workflow_id` to only list tasks created from a specific workflow. ### Pagination Use `page` and `limit`. The response includes `total_pages` and `total_count`.

workflow_id.description: Only return tasks created from this workflow ID.

operations.name: Resume a paused task
operations.description: Resumes execution of a previously paused task. - The task will continue from where it was paused. - You **can't** resume a task that is `finished`, `failed`, or `canceled`.

operations.name: Run a workflow (create a task)
operations.description: Starts a new task execution for a workflow and returns a `task_id`. ### How it works 1) Choose a workflow in the Dashboard and copy its `workflow_id` 2) Provide any `input_parameters` required by the workflow 3) Optionally enable `save_browser_data` to receive a `profile_id` that can be reused later ### Webhooks You can provide `callback_url` and/or `status_change_callback_url` to receive POST not

save_browser_data.description: If `true`, the response will include a `profile_id`. You can reuse that `profile_id` in later runs to reuse browser data (e.g., cookies).

profile_id.description: Reuse browser data from a previous run (e.g., cookies) by providing a `profile_id`.

callback_url.description: Optional. HTTP/HTTPS URL to receive a POST notification when the task **finishes**, **fails**, or is **canceled**. Maximum length: 2048 characters. Must be publicly reachable (no private/local addresses).

status_change_callback_url.description: Optional. HTTP/HTTPS URL to receive a POST notification whenever the task status changes (e.g., running, paused, finished, canceled, failed). Maximum length: 2048 characters. Must be publicly reachable (no private/local addresses).

operations.name: Run an official workflow template (create a task)
operations.description: Starts a new task execution from an **official workflow template** and returns a `task_id`. Use `GET /v2/workflow/list-official-workflow-templates` to discover templates.

proxyRegion.description: Optional. Proxy region code. Defaults to `US`.

workflow_template_id.description: The official workflow template ID to run.

operations.name: Cancel a running task
operations.description: Cancels a running task immediately. - Use this when you no longer need the result. - A canceled task **cannot** be resumed. **Tip:** If you only need to check progress, prefer `GET /v2/workflow/get-task-status`.

biz_code.description: Optional business cancellation code (for your own tracking/analytics).
